Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /app/test/04-higher-order.scm:
     1	;; Test 4: Higher-order functions and closures
     2	
     3	;; Function that returns a function
     4	(define (make-adder n)
     5	  (lambda (x) (+ x n)))
     6	
     7	(define add5 (make-adder 5))
     8	(define add10 (make-adder 10))
     9	
    10	;; add5(3)
    11	(display (add5 3))
    12	(newline)
    13	
    14	;; add10(3)
    15	(display (add10 3))
    16	(newline)
    17	
    18	;; Compose function
    19	(define (compose f g)
    20	  (lambda (x) (f (g x))))
    21	
    22	(define square (lambda (x) (* x x)))
    23	(define inc (lambda (x) (+ x 1)))
    24	
    25	(define square-then-inc (compose inc square))
    26	(define inc-then-square (compose square inc))
    27	
    28	;; square-then-inc(5)
    29	(display (square-then-inc 5))
    30	(newline)
    31	
    32	;; inc-then-square(5)
    33	(display (inc-then-square 5))
    34	(newline)
    35	
    36	;; Fold/reduce
    37	(define (fold-left f init lst)
    38	  (if (null? lst)
    39	      init
    40	      (fold-left f (f init (car lst)) (cdr lst))))
    41	
    42	;; Sum of 1-5
    43	(display (fold-left + 0 '(1 2 3 4 5)))
    44	(newline)
    45	
    46	;; Product of 1-5
    47	(display (fold-left * 1 '(1 2 3 4 5)))
    48	(newline)
